Bare text followed by a paragraph inside a blockquote gets a blank-line separator instead of merging into one line

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<blockquote>Just text, then <p>a paragraph</p></blockquote>", ConversionOptions())
    println(result)
}
```
